collection.title: Mercedes-Benz C Class Convertible 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz C Class Cabriolet 2016 Onwards (C205) model requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz wiper arm attachment and all of the following blades will fit.
